title: Blazer, Sharpened
concept: Where precision tailoring becomes sculptural form.
description: A digital reconstruction of a Mugler tailored blazer, exploring the tension between architectural structure and body-contouring design. The sharply extended shoulders contrast with a sculpted waist, defined by intricate side lacing. An asymmetric concealed fastening, angular lapels, and structured flap pockets complete the silhouette, recreated with a focus on precise tailoring and controlled fabric volume.

construction.fit: Body-contouring tailored fit with a sharply defined waist and exaggerated, angular shoulders.
construction.collar: Notched lapels with an integrated collar construction, forming a sharp, elongated V-shaped neckline.
construction.pockets: Two structured hip-level flap pockets, positioned on the front panels.
construction.seams: Clean panel seams with minimal visible topstitching, side lacing, and a concealed asymmetric front fastening.
construction.fabric: Black lightweight wool suiting, inspired by tropical wool, with a fine texture and structured drape.
construction.volume: Strong, pointed shoulder volume contrasts with a tightly sculpted waist and a subtly flared lower silhouette.

reference.caption: Mugler tailored lace-up blazer — original design referenced for shoulder architecture, waist shaping, and garment construction.
